title: Second-Level Collapse Under a Circuit Hypothesis
statement: Suppose every language in NP is decidable by a family of fan-in-two Boolean circuits whose sizes are bounded by a polynomial in the input length. Then every language in $\Pi_2^P$ belongs to $\Sigma_2^P$.
hypotheses_covered: Every language in NP has a fan-in-two circuit family with size bounded by $a(n+1)^k$ for some natural numbers $a,k$
